signals.summary: eBay announced it was closing TCGplayer's Syracuse authentication center and moving operations to Kentucky, eliminating about 220 unionized jobs.
Law firm investigates possible WARN Act violations over the Syracuse mass layoff of about 215 employees at TCGplayer.
Union members ratified a closing agreement with eBay/TCGplayer that substantially improved severance, COBRA and mental health benefits.
Parent company eBay reported $2 billion in profits the prior year, per the union's account.
